programs.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programs.desc: Robert Wagner stars as the infamous outlaw in Nicholas Ray's western, which follows the last 18 years of the robber's life.

programs.title: Sister Act 2: Back in the Habit
programs.desc: Comedy sequel starring Whoopi Goldberg and Lauryn Hill. Deloris - who's now made it big in Vegas - goes back undercover as a teacher to help a struggling school choir find its voice.

programs.title: The Perfect Catch
programs.desc: Comedy. Ben (Jimmy Fallon) must choose between his two loves: Lindsey (Drew Barrymore) and the Boston Red Sox baseball team. Based on Nick Hornby's novel Fever Pitch.

programs.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programs.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan. A bereaved man gets another chance at love when his son puts him on a radio talk show.

programs.title: Inglourious Basterds
programs.desc: Quentin Tarantino's World War II action-adventure. Jewish American soldiers go Nazi-hunting in occupied France. With Brad Pitt, Diane Kruger, Christoph Waltz and Michael Fassbender.

programs.title: The Frighteners
programs.desc: Peter Jackson's comedy horror stars Michael J Fox as a psychic investigator in a town that has more ghouls and ghosties than you can shake a spirit stick at. But is he a fraud.

programs.title: Undergods
programs.desc: Dystopian fantasy that weaves together three eerie tales of doomed modernity, framed by the day-to-day of two garbage men who collect corpses from the streets of a ruined estate.

programs.title: Animal Farm
programs.desc: George Orwell's cautionary tale reimagined in cartoon form. A farm's animals revolt against their abusive owner only for the pigs to become drunk with their newly found power.

programs.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
programs.desc: Supernatural romance starring Rex Harrison as the spirit of a gruff sea captain who haunts widow Gene Tierney, only for her to fall in love with him. Directed by Joseph L Mankiewicz.

programs.title: Destination Gobi
programs.desc: Fact-based Second World War adventure. Richard Widmark stars as a US Navy officer who leads an alliance of scientists and tribesmen against the Japanese in Mongolia.
